ideas.why_it_beats_the_limiter:
Quick checks on raw data (my scripts; fast grids Bench(60,160) + the envh selection bench, kinematics on Bench(110,360); held-out set not touched).
(1) Reach ceiling (window only, knee-less plain 3R at the lead's seats). Without a relay it closes 216/360 (a2 57.2) or 237/360 (a2 64). The lead takes 262. With this pin axis it closes 312/360 at PHI 60 and 326/360 at PHI 75 (overhead 24/28; 331 at a2 67). The tilt-12/taz-237 family reaches 314 and 322. Over the whole sphere of relay axes the ceiling is flat at 321-329 (PHI 75, a2 64) for tilt 15-60, taz 45-180. So the axis can be chosen for hardware, not kinematics.
(2) The limiter it removes is the torso cap on every arc guide. Wall map at the pad station, R 82-86: un-relayed poses are free only for theta_rel -48..+36 from the pad azimuth; relayed poses only for -36..+66. kfree-armarc's arc (starting at the pad, R 78, PHI 45) reproduces its chest death: 18 (b60) and 10 (envh) un-relayed contacts. The pin needs no arc. The only arm-fixed metal is a Ø12 boss where the axis leaves the skin, 98-99 mm from GH (max over 490 poses).
(3) Member 3 placed rigidly in the RELAYED frame (hub 3 + bar at the max-over-poses first-exit radius + 2 mm): 0 contacts with the whole posed body (torso, head) at PHI 75 on both benches. 0 relayed poses within 2 mm; 3 poses at the 2-mm floor, which are the binders. Relay lift 0.0 mm: the relayed frame needs no more height than phi 0. Hub 2's ray requirement on clip poses is unchanged (p50 52.5 / p90 55 mm, the same as the plain 3R).
(4) Continuity (kinematic flood, 1432-node envelope grid, 2-deg slerp, relay step <= 10 deg): 1280 closable and 1280 connected (366 relayed, 0 islands). The fit clips never relay.
(5) Same-instrument kit reading (concept_kit, Bench(60,160) fast, q 0.95, a2 64). Control 60.55. Pin ideal relay: 41.98 when the fit includes relayed poses, 46.07 when the shape is frozen from phi 0. Pin hardware (bar + boss): 47.84 and 49.93. Tilt-12 ideal: 30.89 and 55.74. So the pin wins by 9.7 frozen and loses by 11 with the relayed poses in the fit; the cause is hub 2 / link 1 in band 0.90/0.96 -> 0.50/0.76. Kit absolutes are not claims: its control is far below the lead model's own metal. Prior: the ideal tilt-12 relay with the knee reads 10.22 frozen exact; +4 closable and the +2.2 knee-less price project a bound of about 11-13 in a lead-quality model.
